setup_batch_predict_server: setup a Ray Serve deployment for batched MLIP inference with configurable batch size and OOM splitting
BatchPredictServer_predict: predict batched AtomicData objects with automatic OOM recovery and batch splitting on out of memory errors
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the maximum batch size and wait timeout for the Ray Serve batched prediction deployment
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual per-system and per-atom prediction dictionaries
BatchPredictServer_get_predict_unit_attr: get an attribute from the underlying MLIP predict unit by its name at runtime
